# spaceman prompt

Prompt catalog: list, show, create, save a draft and publish.

Aliases: `prompts`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman prompt create`](#spaceman-prompt-create) | Add a prompt (with a first draft) |
| [`spaceman prompt draft`](#spaceman-prompt-draft) | Save the prompt's draft (starts one when there is none) |
| [`spaceman prompt get`](#spaceman-prompt-get) | A prompt with its draft and versions (ID or slug) |
| [`spaceman prompt list`](#spaceman-prompt-list) | The prompt catalog |
| [`spaceman prompt publish`](#spaceman-prompt-publish) | Publish the draft as the next immutable version |

## spaceman prompt create

Add a prompt (with a first draft).

```sh
spaceman prompt create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `create-prompt` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string |  | first draft |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--kind` | string |  | role, dream, kb, event or general (required) |
| `--name` | string |  | name (required) |

## spaceman prompt draft

Save the prompt's draft (starts one when there is none).

```sh
spaceman prompt draft <prompt> [flags]
```

API: `get-prompt`, `save-prompt-draft` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman prompt draft control --body-file control.md --notes "tighten escalation"
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--body` | string |  | draft text (required) |
| `--body-file` | string |  | read --body from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--extends` | string |  | a published version of another prompt to build on |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--notes` | string |  | change notes |

## spaceman prompt get

A prompt with its draft and versions (ID or slug).

```sh
spaceman prompt get <prompt> [flags]
```

API: `get-prompt` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman prompt list

The prompt catalog.

```sh
spaceman prompt list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-prompts` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman prompt publish

Publish the draft as the next immutable version.

```sh
spaceman prompt publish <prompt> [flags]
```

API: `get-prompt`, `publish-prompt` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
